MECHANISM_GATE_checked_first.verdict: CLEAN INSTRUMENT, and now fully verified with no inferred items. The carry was live and it changed nothing.

PRIMARY_RESULT.reading: A DEAD TIE. 42 against a pooled control of exactly 42.0, and inside the measured null against both individual runs.

ROTATION_DECISION: UNCHANGED, all-in on G-flashnext48k. Rule 9b forbids firing a config we have evidence is worse, and forbids equally a config we have no evidence is better. GG5 is a measured tie with a mechanism that did not fire.

THE_MECHANISM_COUNTERS_WHICH_THE_GATE_CA.verdict: THE MECHANISM DID NOT FIRE. All three counters moved the wrong way, all within noise. Giving this model its own last two turns of thinking did not make its turns shorter, which is the entire causal claim behind the arm.

THE_N1_FOLLOW_UP_built_but_NOT_recommend.bundle: solution/kaggle/generated/arc3-q38-flashnext-rcarry1-v1, REASONING_CARRY_TURNS 2 -> 1, SOURCE_IDENTITY rehashed, serving_setup compiles. One command from a push if wanted.
THE_N1_FOLLOW_UP_built_but_NOT_recommend.recommendation: CLOSE the reasoning-carry family on GG5's evidence: clean instrument, dead tie on levels, no counter outside its null. Keep the N=1 bundle on the shelf. Reopen only if a later arm gives a reason to believe carried reasoning would behave differently, for example if GG8 makes the world model real and the thing worth carrying changes from prose to a certified artifact.
THE_N1_FOLLOW_UP_built_but_NOT_recommend.the_honest_summary_of_the_arm: Not 'carrying reasoning hurts'. It is 'carrying two turns of reasoning changes nothing measurable on this model at this context budget', which is a null, and nulls are what the +/-14% band exists to identify.
why_I_am_NOT_recommending_it_anyway: The trigger did not strictly fire. The gate qualifies the counter with 'its null is +/-14%, so only a move beyond +/-14% counts.' Tokens per decision moved +5.5%, which is INSIDE the null. So no counter moved significantly in either direction and the arm is a clean null, not a positive-cost reading.
Both sides shrink together. At N=1 the carried text halves, so any cost AND any benefit halve. Starting from a measured nothing, the expected information from halving it is close to zero.

It costs a full run. Corrected today: a bench is about 2.4 GPU-h regardless of game count, so the 2026-09-12 refresh buys about 12 runs. Spending one on a formality is a real cost against GG7, GG8, GG9 and their replicates.
THE_N1_FOLLOW_UP_built_but_NOT_recommend.why_the_gate_named_it: Verbatim: 'Tokens/decision UP means the carried text is being re-read rather than reused, and N should go to 1 before the family is closed.'

subject: The Astra reasoning-state lever does NOT transfer to an open-weight 176B MoE at N=2. First open-weight data point on it.
why_this_is_worth_publishing: Every published instance of the reasoning-state lever runs a closed frontier model, and ARC Prize's own Astra numbers (62.7% to 99.9% on Semi-Private) are the headline case for it. This is the first open-weight measurement of that lever on this benchmark, and it is negative at N=2 with a clean instrument and a gate written in advance.
